items.exampleEn: Do you believe in the existence of life on other planets?
items.exampleZh: 你相信其他星球上有生命存在嗎？

items.exampleEn: Good reading skills are the foundation of learning.
items.exampleZh: 良好的閱讀能力是學習的基礎。

items.exampleEn: The new road was a disaster for local shops.
items.exampleZh: 新道路對當地商店來說是一場災難。

items.exampleEn: The weather here can vary a lot in one day.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的天氣一天之內可能變化很大。

items.exampleEn: What is the origin of this word?
I don't want to be a burden to my family.
items.exampleZh: 我不想成為家人的負擔。

items.exampleEn: The destruction of forests is a serious problem.
items.exampleZh: 森林遭到破壞是很嚴重的問題。

items.sentenceEn: Opening hours vary on holidays, so please check our website.
items.sentenceZh: 假日的營業時間會不同，請上我們的網站查詢。

items.audioEn: The house has a strong foundation, so it's safe even in strong winds.
items.audioZh: 這棟房子的地基很穩，所以即使颳強風也很安全。
items.questionZh: 這棟房子為什麼很安全？
options: It is built on a solid base.

items.sentenceEn: Heavy bags can be a real burden on a long trip.
items.sentenceZh: 長途旅行時，重重的包包真的是一種負擔。

items.sentenceEn: Nobody knows the exact origin of this old song.
items.sentenceZh: 沒有人知道這首老歌確切的起源。

items.stemEn: Rain all day turned our picnic into a ____.
items.stemZh: 下了一整天的雨，讓我們的野餐變成一場災難。

items.stemEn: Students from abroad ____ ten percent of our school.
items.stemZh: 外國學生占我們學校的百分之十。

items.passageEn: The old tea house in our town has a long history. Its origin goes back more than one hundred years. A small fire in 1990 caused the destruction of its kitchen, but the family who owns it built it again. Prices of tea vary, but most are relatively cheap. For the owner, the old wooden building is a burden because it needs a lot of repair. Still, she says the tea house is the foundation of the town's culture. Today, visitors constitute most of her customers. Without them, the tea house's existence would be in danger.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮上的老茶館歷史悠久，它的起源可以追溯到一百多年前。1990 年的一場小火燒毀了它的廚房，但經營茶館的家族又把它重建起來。茶的價格不一，但大多相對便宜。對店主來說，這棟老木屋是個負擔，因為需要大量修繕。不過她說，茶館是小鎮文化的基礎。現在，她的客人大多是遊客。沒有他們，茶館的存在就會岌岌可危。

questions.questionZh: 茶館的起源可以追溯到多久以前？
現在茶館的客人大多是什麼人？

items.promptZh: 每個人的意見都不一樣。
referenceEn: Opinions vary from person to person.
rubricZh: vary 表示「不同、有差異」，是不及物動詞
主詞是複數，用 vary（不加 s）
寫 Everyone has a different opinion. 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 burden 造一個句子，說說一件讓你覺得是負擔的事。
referenceEn: Paying the rent every month is a big burden for me.
I feel that too much homework is a burden.
rubricZh: burden 表示「負擔」，可用 a burden for／to＋人（例如 a burden for me）
說的是自己的感受（例如 I、me）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was）
